nodes.text: You're the one who brought Grettir's tools up. Then you'll want this too: there's a count in my book twenty years open. A crew's pay, drawn, never spent. The digmaster's hoard has it: a pay-tin, dented, theirs.
Because a ledger with one line open isn't closed. I don't run a market on top of an open count.
Southeast, past the warrens, where the stolen crates are stacked. The big digger holds the hoard. Lamp-oil's on your own account.
It's waited twenty years. It can wait for you.
